name: Dominate Monster
body:
Source PRPG Core Rulebook pg. 274
School enchantment (compulsion) [mind-affecting]; Level arcanist 9, psychic 9, sorcerer 9, summoner 6, witch 9, wizard 9
Casting
Casting Time 1 round
Components V, S
Effect
Range close (25 ft. + 5 ft./2 levels)
Target one creature
Duration 1 day/level
Saving Throw Will negates; Spell Resistance yes
Description
This spell functions like dominate person, except that the spell is not restricted by creature type.
